nodes.label: Implementation Philosophy — The Fundamental Dependency Chain
nodes.rationale: The system is not a set of independent features but a dependency graph of data: gap analysis cannot work unless topics are extracted from curriculum, study plans cannot be ordered without prerequisite relationships, exam validation cannot check CLO coverage without question-to-CLO matching, and the AI tutor cannot explain a concept that doesn't exist as a graph node. Implementation order is therefore dictated by what data must exist before downstream operations are possible, not by stakeholder priority. Section 1.3's Interdependency Summary Map shows every subsequent phase (2-5) consumes Phase 1 outputs (book parsing, topic graph, CLO matching, cross-grade links) as a hard requirement.

nodes.label: Phase 1 — Curriculum Intelligence Foundation
nodes.rationale: The only phase that must be completely correct before any other work begins; every feature in every other phase traverses the graph built here. Comprises Capabilities 1A (ingestion), 1B (Neo4j graph construction), 1C (CLO matching), 1D (cross-grade prerequisites). Duration 8-10 weeks. In the existing codebase, 1A and 1B correspond to already-implemented curriculum upload/parsing/sync functionality; 1C and 1D are NOT yet built.

nodes.label: Capability 1A — Curriculum Document Ingestion Pipeline
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: Nothing — this is the root of the entire system. DELIVERABLE: parsed curriculum structure (units/chapters/topics/subtopics) written to PostgreSQL and Neo4j, human-reviewed and approved. Uses PyMuPDF/Apache POI for structure extraction, heading-hierarchy detection, TOC-first parsing, and an AI (Claude/Qwen) fallback for unstructured text, with a mandatory human review queue before Neo4j writes. This corresponds to already-implemented codebase functionality (curriculum upload + worker parsing).

nodes.label: Capability 1B — Neo4j Curriculum Graph Construction
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: Capability 1A — approved parsed curriculum structure must exist. DELIVERABLE: all subjects, units, topics, subtopics written as Neo4j nodes with structural relationships (HAS_UNIT, HAS_TOPIC, etc). The graph topology itself is described as 'the intelligence' — it determines what gap analysis finds, what study plans recommend, and what the AI tutor knows. Corresponds to already-implemented codebase functionality (curriculum graph sync).

nodes.label: Capability 1C — CLO Matching and Verification
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: 1A (topics exist in Neo4j) + CLO document from Ministry. DELIVERABLE: all topics linked to CLOs via MAPS_TO_CLO edges, no topic matchless, human review complete. Most technically sensitive step in Phase 1 — three CLO sources (MOE document, book's own objectives, AI-inferred) reconciled via multilingual-e5-large embeddings + pgvector cosine similarity (>0.85 auto-accept, 0.65-0.85 human review, <0.65 AI drafts a new CLO for review). NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in the current codebase — this is aspirational relative to existing curriculum upload/parsing code.

nodes.label: Capability 1D — Cross-Grade Prerequisite Graph
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: 1B (topic nodes in Neo4j) + curriculum books for at least 2 consecutive grades. DELIVERABLE: full cross-grade prerequisite graph, validated as a DAG, AI-inferred links reviewed. Section 1.2 rationale ('Why Cross-Grade Relationships Are Non-Negotiable'): naive gap analysis on a failed topic (e.g. Grade 10 'Newton's Second Law') only finds the symptom; the real root cause may be an earlier-grade prerequisite (e.g. Grade 9 'Vector Addition' via 'Net Force') that was never mastered. Telling the student to re-study the symptom topic will not help — the correct intervention is to go back to the unmastered prerequisite. This is only possible if the prerequisite graph spans grades, so cross-grade linking must be built in Phase 1, not added later, because every later phase depends on correct traversal depth. Sources of prerequisites: explicit textbook cross-references ('Recall from Grade 9'), an authoritative MOE prerequisite document if available, and AI-inferred links (all requiring curriculum-officer approval). Validated via cycle detection (must be a DAG), a 5-grade-level depth limit, and an orphan-topic check. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in the current codebase.

nodes.label: Phase 1 — Integration Test Suite (QA Gate)
nodes.rationale: Seven mandatory integration tests gate the start of Phase 2, including: 100% topic node coverage on book upload, ≥40% of Grade 10 topics having Grade 9 prerequisites, all Grade 10 topics having ≥1 CLO match, correct CLO cosine-similarity top match, successful cross-grade prerequisite traversal query, cycle detection rejecting artificially introduced cycles, and no auto-accepted CLO match existing below 0.85 similarity. 'Phase 1 is done only when all 7 tests pass. No exceptions.'

nodes.label: Phase 2 — Exam & Assessment Infrastructure
nodes.rationale: Makes the curriculum graph useful to teachers by validating every exam question's curriculum alignment before students see it. Comprises Capabilities 2A (exam upload/parsing), 2B (exam validation report), 2C (student answer ingestion). Duration 6-8 weeks, starts after Phase 1 integration tests pass.

nodes.label: Capability 2A — Exam Upload and Parsing
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: Phase 1 complete — CLO nodes and topic nodes must exist for alignment to work. Parses uploaded exam PDFs/DOCX into Question nodes (PyMuPDF + regex), embeds question text via multilingual-e5-large for CLO similarity matching.

nodes.label: Capability 2B — Exam Validation Report
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: 2A (exam + questions in Neo4j with CLO alignment) + Phase 1 complete. DELIVERABLE: exam validation report API letting a teacher iterate before publishing. Flagship Phase 2 feature — flags missing mandatory CLO coverage, Bloom's taxonomy imbalance, difficulty-distribution mismatch, absent topics, and cross-grade prerequisite warnings (e.g. a question assumes an earlier-grade concept the students may not have mastered).

nodes.label: Capability 2C — Student Answer Ingestion
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: 2A (exams + questions exist) + Phase 1 (topic nodes exist for future traversal). DELIVERABLE: student answers stored in PostgreSQL (source of truth) with async ANSWERED/ATTEMPTED edges synced to Neo4j via a Go worker consuming a PostgreSQL logical replication slot, retried through a Bull MQ queue on failure. This is the data that feeds all of Phase 3.

nodes.label: Phase 3 — Student Intelligence Layer
nodes.rationale: 'Where the investment in Phase 1 pays off. Without the cross-grade prerequisite graph, gap analysis returns symptom topics. With it, gap analysis returns root causes.' Comprises Capabilities 3A (gap analysis), 3B (study plan generator), 3C (AI tutor), 3D (career recommendation). Duration 8-10 weeks, starts after Phase 2 integration tests pass. NOT YET IMPLEMENTED in the current codebase.

nodes.label: Capability 3A — Gap Analysis Engine
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: Phase 1 (CLO graph + cross-grade prerequisites) + Phase 2 (student answers). DELIVERABLE: gap analysis API — every student gets a gap list with root causes identified. Two-pass algorithm: Pass 1 collects surface (symptom) gaps from failed questions traversed to CLOs to topics; Pass 2 walks PREREQUISITE_OF edges upstream (1-5 hops) to find the deepest unmastered ancestor topic — the root cause. Severity = (marks lost/total) × (prerequisite depth/5) × (mandatory CLO weight); severity > 0.7 is flagged critical.

nodes.label: Capability 3B — Study Plan Generator
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: 3A (gap analysis complete) + Phase 1 (prerequisite graph + estimatedHours on topics). DELIVERABLE: a topologically-correct study plan API where prerequisites always precede dependents. Uses Neo4j GDS gds.dag.topologicalSort over the student's gap subgraph, prioritizes within tiers by exam date/mandatory-CLO/severity, estimates time per topic, and enriches each day with an LLM (Qwen-7B) plain-language study goal.

nodes.label: Capability 3C — AI Tutor / Academic Assistant
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: Phase 1 (topic concepts + CLO descriptions in Neo4j) + 3A (gap list for context). DELIVERABLE: AI tutor API where all responses are curriculum-grounded via graph context injection, not the LLM's raw training data — it queries HAS_CONCEPT and PREREQUISITE_OF edges to build prompt context including the student's known gaps, and also generates CLO-aligned practice problems (teacher-reviewed before serving to students).

nodes.label: Capability 3D — Career Recommendation Engine
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: Phase 1 (topic graph) + 3A (mastered/struggled edges) + career seed data. DELIVERABLE: career recommendation API with readiness scores and gap-to-career focused study plans. Career nodes link to required Topic nodes via REQUIRES edges (manually seeded by curriculum officers from known university admission requirements); readiness scored as % of required topics already mastered by the student.

nodes.label: MOE National CLO Document (Ministry external input)
nodes.rationale: Authoritative Excel/CSV from the Ministry of Education: subjectCode, gradeLevel, cloCode, description, bloomLevel, mandatory per row. Ingested idempotently via MERGE and embedded with multilingual-e5-large for topic matching. Listed under section 7.2 as a non-engineering dependency the Ministry must deliver in Phase 1.

nodes.label: Career-to-Topic Requirements Seed Dataset
nodes.rationale: One-time, manually curated by curriculum officers from known Ethiopian university admission requirements, e.g. 'Electrical Engineering requires Grade 10 Electromagnetic Induction, Grade 11 Circuit Analysis...'. A prerequisite input for Capability 3D.

nodes.label: Phase 4 — Teacher & School Intelligence
nodes.rationale: Aggregates student-level intelligence upward to class and school level, surfacing patterns invisible when looking at individual students. Comprises Capabilities 4A (class gap heatmap), 4B (exam quality scoring), 4C (school quality scoring). Duration 6-8 weeks, starts after Phase 3 core (3A+3B) is stable in production.

nodes.label: Capability 4A — Class-Wide Gap Heatmap
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: Phase 3A (gap records with STRUGGLED_WITH edges) + Phase 1 (prerequisite graph). DELIVERABLE: class gap heatmap API with cross-grade root-cause alerts for teachers, e.g. auto-detecting that a class-wide Grade 10 struggle traces back to an inadequately covered Grade 9 concept when >40% of students share the same struggle.

nodes.label: Capability 4B — Exam Quality Scoring
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: Phase 2C (student answers) + Phase 2B (CLO alignment) + Phase 1 (CLO-topic graph). DELIVERABLE: exam quality report API — retroactively scores whether questions discriminated between students who mastered a CLO and those who didn't, and flags miscalibrated difficulty.

nodes.label: Capability 4C — School Quality Scoring
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: 4A + 4B + all Phase 2 and Phase 3 data populated. DELIVERABLE: school quality score API, nightly recalculation job, school admin dashboard feed. Composite formula: 0.30×CLO coverage + 0.25×student mastery% + 0.25×avg exam quality + 0.20×curriculum compliance, recalculated nightly via Celery and cached in Redis.

nodes.label: Phase 5 — Regional & Ministry Intelligence
nodes.rationale: Elevates the system from a school tool to a national intelligence platform, aggregating every previous phase's outputs across all 50,000+ schools. Comprises Capabilities 5A (regional analytics), 5B (Ministry national intelligence dashboard), 5C (School Box offline sync hardening), 5D (performance at national scale). Duration 8-10 weeks, starts after Phase 4 is stable.

nodes.label: Capability 5A — Regional Analytics
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: Phase 4 (school quality scores + gap records at scale). DELIVERABLE: regional analytics API, cross-school gap heatmap, root-cause distribution by region — e.g. surfacing that a widely-shared root-cause gap across a region indicates a teacher-training problem rather than an individual student problem.

nodes.label: Capability 5B — Ministry National Intelligence Dashboard
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: All previous phases; specifically requires Phase 4 quality scores and Phase 3 gap records at national scale. DELIVERABLE: Ministry intelligence API, anonymized aggregate views, policy recommendation engine. Data sovereignty: a PostgreSQL view strips student PII into anonymous cohort identifiers before aggregation — individual student records are never returned at the Ministry level.

nodes.label: Capability 5C — School Box Offline Sync (Production Hardening)
nodes.rationale: DEPENDS ON: All phases operational; full student dataset available for sync validation. DELIVERABLE: production-grade sync with conflict resolution tested against a 50,000 School Box simulation. Includes CRDT-style conflict resolution for exam grading (explicit teacher override always wins over auto-grading), chronological offline-answer flushing, post-sync gap-analysis re-runs against the fuller cloud prerequisite graph, and Ollama model update propagation.

nodes.label: Capability 5D — Performance at National Scale
nodes.rationale: No explicit 'DEPENDS ON' line in the source, but the phase-level intro states Phase 5 'starts after Phase 4 is stable,' and this capability addresses queries that only degrade once the full dataset (26M+ students, 500K+ teachers, 50,000+ schools) is loaded. Work items: Neo4j query profiling/composite indexes, PostgreSQL partitioning by grade_level/academic_year, nightly Ministry aggregate materialization, Redis result caching with tiered TTLs, and read-replica routing via Kong for Ministry bulk exports.

nodes.label: Critical Path Items (Section 7.1)
nodes.rationale: Items that, if delayed, delay every phase after them and should be assigned to the most experienced engineer immediately: the curriculum document parser (1A, all other work blocked on it), the Neo4j schema + CLO matching pipeline (1B+1C, must be correct before Phase 2), cross-grade prerequisite ingestion/validation (1D, cannot be an afterthought), the PostgreSQL-to-Neo4j sync worker (first used in 2C, needed every phase after Phase 2), and the multilingual-e5-large embedding model deployment for CLO matching.

nodes.label: Cross-Cutting Concern — Data Migration and Versioning
nodes.rationale: Runs continuously across all phases rather than being a phase itself. Every PostgreSQL schema change goes through Flyway (db/migrations/V{version}__{description}.sql, always backward-compatible — never drop or rename-without-alias a column); every Neo4j schema change goes through a custom migration runner (neo4j/migrations/{version}_{description}.cypher), with documented rollback procedures. 'Skipping them to ship faster creates debt that is much more expensive to fix after users are in the system.'

nodes.label: Cross-Cutting Concern — Multi-Tenancy Enforcement
nodes.rationale: Enforced at four simultaneous layers so a single layer's failure cannot expose cross-tenant data: (1) Kong JWT validation extracting schoolId/regionId from token claims, (2) Go middleware carrying schoolId/regionId in request context, (3) PostgreSQL RLS policies enforcing school_id match on every student-scoped table, (4) Neo4j RBAC restricting Ministry users to anonymized aggregate projections rather than individual student nodes.

nodes.label: Cross-Cutting Concern — API Versioning
nodes.rationale: All APIs versioned from day one under /api/v1/. Breaking changes require a new /api/v2/ with a 90-day deprecation sunset for /api/v1/, since School Boxes that may not update immediately must keep working during the deprecation window.

nodes.label: Cross-Cutting Concern — Testing Strategy by Phase
nodes.rationale: Layered test strategy scaling with phase maturity: unit tests all phases (testify/pytest/Vitest, >80% coverage gate), integration tests all phases (Testcontainers with real PostgreSQL+Neo4j+Redis on every PR), graph traversal tests from Phase 1 onward (critical for cross-grade prerequisite correctness), end-to-end Playwright tests from Phase 2 onward (nightly), load tests from Phase 4+ (k6, 50,000 concurrent students, P99<400ms), and chaos tests in Phase 5 (Chaos Monkey: kill pods, inject DB latency, simulate School Box disconnection).

nodes.label: Cross-Cutting Concern — Documentation Requirements
nodes.rationale: Every API endpoint documented in OpenAPI 3.1 (via swaggo from Go annotations); every Cypher query annotated with its performance profile and index requirements; an ADR written for every non-obvious technical decision; a runbook for every Celery background job (what it does, when it runs, how to manually trigger, how to check for failure).
